newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 8.486 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 8.486 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 77-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.486 percent versus 7.251 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 168-day treasury bills was 7.995 percent versus 7.009 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 329-day treasury bills was 7.72 percent versus 6.942 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
